items.title_en: We are going to kill "unalive"
items.title_zh: 我们要废除 unalive 这一说法
items.summary_en: Anildash critiques sanitized language around suicide and advocates returning to direct, compassionate communication online. The piece argues that euphemisms can obscure urgency and hinder support, while clear terminology can help communities respond more effectively to at-risk individuals.
items.summary_zh: Anildash 批评在网络讨论中将自杀等话题用委婉措辞处理，呼吁回归直接而富有同情心的表达方式。文章认为委婉说法可能模糊紧急性，阻碍对处于风险中的群体提供有效支持。

items.title_en: ChatGPT is adding real cartoonists' signatures to fake New Yorker cartoons
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 将真实漫画家的签名添加到假冒的《纽约客》漫画中
items.summary_en: AI-generated cartoons are now reported to carry signatures from real cartoonists, raising intellectual property and attribution concerns as authorship lines blur. This development underscores the challenges of provenance in AI-generated art and the potential need for watermarking or policy safeguards.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成的漫画如今被指会带上真实漫画家的签名，这模糊了署名与版权的边界，凸显了 AI 生成作品在来源认定上的挑战以及对水印与政策保护的潜在需求。

items.title_en: Why Common Lisp is now the best programming language
items.title_zh: 为何 Common Lisp 现在是最佳编程语言
items.summary_en: Vivien Henz argues that Common Lisp's macro system, homoiconicity, and minimal runtime yield unrivaled metaprogramming and rapid DSL creation. The piece contends Lisp's simplicity on a philosophical level makes it exceptionally productive for long-lived, complex systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为 Common Lisp 的宏机制、同构性和极小的运行时开销，使其在元编程和快速构建领域无出其右。作者主张 Lisp 的简洁性和长期可维护性使其在处理复杂、长期的软件系统时更具生产力。

items.title_en: Beam: Reflection's 501B open-weight model
items.title_zh: Beam：Reflection 的 501B 开放权重模型发布
items.summary_en: Reflection AI rolls out Beam 501B as an open-weight model, allowing researchers to run a large language model locally without gateways. This expands access and invites community evaluation, with emphasis on safety and alignment considerations.
items.summary_zh: Reflection AI 发布 Beam 501B 开放权重模型，允许研究者在本地运行大型语言模型，降低对远端服务的依赖。开放权重将推动研究者协同评估，并强调安全与对齐的重要性。

items.title_en: Opus 5.5 agents discover two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates
items.title_zh: Opus 5.5 的代理发现两种室温磁性半导体候选材料
items.summary_en: AI agents in the Opus framework autonomously discovered two candidate room-temperature magnetic semiconductors, pushing spintronics closer to practical devices. This showcases how AI-assisted materials discovery can accelerate breakthroughs that once seemed out of reach.
items.summary_zh: Opus 框架中的 AI 代理自动发现两种室温磁性半导体候选材料，为自旋电子学向实用器件推进带来希望。这体现了 AI 辅助的材料发现能显著加速原本难以实现的突破。

items.title_en: German Bundeswehr Uses AI to Screen Applicants for Right-Wing Extremism
items.title_zh: 德國聯邦國防軍使用 AI 篩查應徵者的右翼極端主義傾向
items.summary_en: Germany's federal armed forces are reportedly deploying AI to screen job applicants for signals of right-wing extremism. While this speeds up risk-based screening, it raises questions about bias, due process, and civil-liberties safeguards in automated vetting of recruits. The move highlights how militaries are piloting ML in personnel decisions, with potential spillovers to other safety-critical hiring.
items.summary_zh: 據報告，德國聯邦國防軍開始用 AI 篩查應徵者中與右翼極端主義相關的信號。此舉提升了篩檢效率，但也引發偏見、程序正當性和公民自由等方面的質疑——自動審核的人員招募日益成為實驗場。此案例反映出軍隊在人才招募中測試機器學習的趨勢及其對其他領域的影響。

items.title_en: Example.com just launched the biggest redesign in decades
items.title_zh: Example.com 发布数十年来最大规模的改版
items.summary_en: Example.com has rolled out a major redesign after years, featuring a refreshed UI, performance improvements, and updated developer tooling. The move signals a push toward modern frontend work and brand refresh.
items.summary_zh: Example.com 多年来首次大规模改版，带来焕然一新的界面、性能提升以及开发工具更新。此举反映出对现代化前端工作流与品牌重塑的重视。

items.title_en: Texas city demands $2M for public records on Flock usage
items.title_zh: 德州一城对 Flock 使用公开记录索要200万美元
items.summary_en: A Texas city seeks a hefty fee for public records about Flock usage, fueling debate over transparency costs, FOIA practices, and how tech data is produced and accessed.
items.summary_zh: 德州一城就 Flock 使用公开记录索要高额费用，引发关于信息公开成本、FOIA 实践以及科技数据产出与获取方式的讨论。

items.title_en: Find the flattest route between any two points in SF
items.title_zh: 在旧金山任意两点之间找到最平坦的路线
items.summary_en: A new tool maps the flattest paths across San Francisco, useful for cyclists and pedestrians who want to minimize climbs. By leveraging elevation data and routing heuristics, it shows how terrain shapes everyday commutes and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: 一个新工具绘制旧金山最平坦的路线，适合希望减少爬坡的骑行和步行者。它结合高程数据与路线策略，揭示地形如何影响日常通勤与无障碍出行。

items.title_en: Photopea creator weighs in on Photosuite project
items.title_zh: Photopea 的创作者就 Photosuite 项目发表观点
items.summary_en: Photopea’s creator weighs in on the Photosuite project, likely voicing opinions on open formats, feature parity, and potential risks of competing web-based editors. The note offers a vendor perspective on interoperability and user expectations.
items.summary_zh: Photopea 的创作者就 Photosuite 项目发表观点，涉及开放格式、功能对等与对等性风险等议题，提供对互操作性与用户期望的洞见。

items.title_en: Web Search API
items.title_zh: 网页搜索 API
items.summary_en: Cloudflare released a Web Search API that lets developers integrate search capabilities into apps with Cloudflare's indexing, safety filters, and ranking. It signals a shift toward programmatic, privacy-conscious search experiences for developers.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 公布了网页搜索 API，开发者可以在应用中集成搜索功能，利用 Cloudflare 的索引、安全过滤和排序。此举推动了面向开发者的可编程、更具隐私保护的搜索体验。

items.title_en: Friendship ended with Deno, now Node is my best friend
items.title_zh: 与 Deno 断交，现在 Node 成为我的最佳选择
items.summary_en: A developer reflects on switching from Deno to Node, citing ecosystem maturity, tooling, and compatibility as decisive factors. The piece offers practical takeaways for developers choosing a JavaScript runtime in production.
items.summary_zh: 作者回顾从 Deno 转向 Node 的经历，强调生态成熟度、工具链与兼容性等因素的决定性作用。为开发者在生产环境中选择 JavaScript 运行时提供了实用的见解。

items.title_en: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge
items.title_zh: Anthropic 日记条目向警方报案，女子面临重罪指控
items.summary_en: A Florida woman used Anthropic's Claude to draft a diary entry and then reported it to police, sparking questions about the role of AI-generated content in investigations and potential legal implications.
items.summary_zh: 一名女子使用 Anthropic 的日记功能草拟条目后向警方报案，此事引发对 AI 生成内容在调查中作用及潜在法律影响的讨论。

items.title_en: Dust: Pretraining Transformers Without Backpropagation
items.title_zh: Dust：无需反向传播的 Transformer 预训练
items.summary_en: Dust introduces a pretraining approach for Transformers that does not rely on backpropagation, exploring alternative optimization or local-target strategies. Early results suggest comparable performance with different training dynamics and potential efficiency gains.
items.summary_zh: Dust 提出一种在不依赖反向传播的情况下对 Transformer 进行预训练的方法，探索替代优化或局部目标策略。初步结果显示在训练动力学与效率方面可能带来不同的优势。

items.title_en: Denmark data breach exposes 8.8M people's personal data
items.title_zh: 丹麦数据泄露曝光880万公民个人信息
items.summary_en: A large Danish data breach exposed personal data for about 8.8 million people due to unauthorized access. The incident underscores government data security risks and the need for stronger access controls, auditing, and breach response measures.
items.summary_zh: 未经授权的访问导致约880万丹麦公民的个人信息被曝光（包括 CPR 编号等）。此事件凸显政府数据安全的脆弱性，强调需要加强访问控制、审计与事件响应。

items.title_en: Resurrecting iChat Audio and Video Conferencing
items.title_zh: 重现 iChat 的音视频会议功能
items.summary_en: An ode to early chat apps, this piece sketches reviving iChat-like audio/video conferencing with modern UX: lightweight, secure, and easy to join. It argues that a simple, elegant conferencing tool could cut friction in remote work, countering feature bloat.
items.summary_zh: 本文怀旧地设想以 iChat 为灵感的现代化音视频会议工具，强调简洁、易用与安全性。作者认为，去繁就简的会话工具能降低远程办公的使用门槛，抵抗功能臃肿。

items.title_en: 'Pull the plug': protesters resort to direct action against AI firms
items.title_zh: ‘拔掉插头’：抗议者对AI公司采取直接行动
items.summary_en: Protesters are turning to direct action against AI firms, signaling growing public pressure over AI ethics, labor, and data practices.
items.summary_zh: 抗议者对AI公司采取直接行动，标志着公众对AI伦理、劳动和数据实践的持续压力在升级。文章评估了此类行动的策略、潜在的法律与安全风险，以及促使群体走向线下行动的动机。

items.title_en: The Future of Mathematics
items.title_zh: 数学的未来
items.summary_en: Terry Tao outlines future directions for mathematics, including computation-assisted proofs, data-driven conjectures, and deeper collaboration between theory and computation.
items.summary_zh: Terry Tao 展望数学未来，强调借助计算辅助证明、数据驱动的猜想，以及理论与计算的深度协作。

items.title_en: The lamps in my house
items.title_zh: 我家里的设计师灯具
items.summary_en: A personal reflection on designer lamps discusses how lighting aesthetics, smart features, and energy efficiency converge in home design.
items.summary_zh: 对设计师灯具的个人反思，探讨灯光美学、智能化与节能在家居设计中的结合。

items.title_en: Apple and a hacker's future
items.title_zh: 苹果与黑客的未来
items.summary_en: Stratechery analyzes how Apple’s platform choices will shape the future for hackers and developers, balancing security with openness and monetization. The piece weighs the tension between control and opportunity in Apple’s ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Stratechery 分析苹果在平台策略上的走向将如何影响黑客与开发者，权衡安全、开放性与商业化之间的关系，讨论在苹果生态系统中的控制与机会之间的张力。

items.title_en: The AI boom is making the cheapest smartphones disappear
items.title_zh: AI 热潮正在让最便宜的智能手机消失
items.summary_en: AI boom and memory-chip shortages at data centers are driving up costs and reducing the availability of ultra-cheap smartphones, widening the digital divide in emerging markets. The piece links hardware constraints to consumer access and growth trajectories.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能热潮及数据中心内存芯片短缺推高成本，导致极便宜的智能手机供应受限，进一步拉大新兴市场的数字鸿沟。文章将硬件约束与你的可及性和移动增长前景联系起来。

items.title_en: Anthropic Subscriptions Offer 5x+ More Value Than OpenAI
items.title_zh: Anthropic 订阅的价值远超 OpenAI
items.summary_en: Anthropic's subscription package is framed as delivering significantly higher value than OpenAI’s, perhaps through better pricing tiers, model access, or usage limits. The piece analyzes why enterprise users might prefer Anthropic’s terms for cost efficiency and predictability.
items.summary_zh: 文章分析 Anthropic 的订阅方案在性价比上远超 OpenAI，可能体现在定价层级、模型接入或使用额度等方面的差异。对于企业用户而言，这种价值主张在成本可控和用量预测方面更具吸引力。

items.title_en: Making a GTK application in Haskell, part 1
items.title_zh: 用 Haskell 搭建 GTK 应用（第一部分）
items.summary_en: Part 1 guides building a GTK app in Haskell, covering bindings, setup, and a simple GUI, illustrating the challenges and rewards of cross-language UI development.
items.summary_zh: 第一部分介绍如何在 Haskell 中使用 GTK 构建应用，覆盖绑定、环境搭建与一个简单的 GUI，展示跨语言 UI 开发的挑战与收益。

items.title_en: Ephemeral Testing
items.title_zh: 短暂测试
items.summary_en: Ephemeral Testing advocates disposable, short-lived tests to accelerate feedback loops, discussing trade-offs and practicalities for fast iteration. The approach emphasizes fast failure and quick learning.
items.summary_zh: 短暂测试主张通过一次性、短时间存在的测试来加速反馈循环，讨论取舍与实操要点，强调快速迭代与快速学习。

items.title_en: Global Solar Atlas: summary of solar power potential globally
items.title_zh: 全球太阳能地图：全球潜力概览
items.summary_en: Global Solar Atlas aggregates regional solar resource data to outline where solar power is most viable and how much capacity is realistically achievable. For developers and policymakers, the atlas helps identify high-potential regions and plan grid and investment needs.
items.summary_zh: 全球太阳能地图汇集各地区的日照资源数据，勾勒出最具可行性的区域和现实可实现的容量。对开发者与决策者而言，该工具有助于识别高潜力区域并规划电网与投资需求。

items.title_en: Samon: Designing a Zen Garden Raking Puzzle
items.title_zh: Samon：设计禅园耙地解谜游戏
items.summary_en: Samon designs a Zen garden rake puzzle, likely a minimal, meditative puzzle where players reproduce Zen rake patterns.
items.summary_zh: Samon 以禅园耙地为题的解谜设计，玩家通过重现沙盘中的耙痕来达成目标。文中讨论了设计约束、玩家探索以及随机性与秩序之间的平衡。

items.title_en: Linux containers in 500 lines of code (2016)
items.title_zh: 用 500 行代码实现 Linux 容器（2016）
items.summary_en: A concise 2016 piece demonstrates Linux containers in about 500 lines of code, highlighting core ideas like namespaces and cgroups and offering a grassroots view of container tech.
items.summary_zh: 一篇 2016 年的简短文章用约 500 行代码展示了 Linux 容器的核心原理，强调命名空间与资源控制的要点，提供了对容器技术的朴素理解。

items.title_en: Qualcomm licenses patents on Huawei’s LogicFolding chip tech
items.title_zh: 高通就华为 LogicFolding 芯片技术授权专利
items.summary_en: Qualcomm signs a patent licensing deal related to Huawei’s LogicFolding chip technology, reflecting ongoing cross-licensing amid geopolitical tech competition.
items.summary_zh: 高通就华为 LogicFolding 芯片技术相关专利完成许可安排，体现全球科技竞争背景下的跨公司许可策略。

items.title_en: Learning Jazz Pianist Style with Cross-Attention Conditioning
items.title_zh: 用跨注意力条件化学习爵士钢琴家的风格
items.summary_en: Researchers train a model to imitate jazz pianist style using cross-attention conditioning, enabling stylized music generation and potential for interactive improvisation.
items.summary_zh: 研究者通过跨注意力条件化，让模型模仿爵士钢琴家的演奏风格，从而实现风格化的音乐生成与潜在的互动即兴。文中讲述注意力机制在节奏、乐句和和声等方面引导细腻表达的方式。

items.title_en: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine: Deisseroth, Hegemann, Nagel
items.title_zh: 2026 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖：德塞洛斯特、赫格曼、纳格尔
items.summary_en: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine honors breakthroughs in optogenetics and neural circuit control, highlighting how light-based techniques enable precise modulation of brain activity and potential therapies.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖表彰在光遗传学与神经回路控制方面的突破，强调光基技术在精确调控脑活动与潜在治疗中的作用。

items.title_en: The technology to eradicate mosquito-borne disease exists
items.title_zh: 消灭蚊媒疾病的技术已经存在
items.summary_en: The piece argues that proven tools—such as Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes, gene drives, and sterile insect techniques—could dramatically reduce mosquito-borne diseases, with governance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为通过 Wolbachia 等技术、基因驱动和昆虫性诱惑等手段，完全消灭蚊媒疾病是可实现的，但需要妥善治理与公众参与。

items.title_en: Better Space-Time Trade-Offs for LSM-Tree Based Key-Value Stores [pdf]
items.title_zh: 针对基于 LSM-树的键值存储的更优空间-时间权衡 [PDF]
items.summary_en: This paper presents improved space-time trade-offs for log-structured merge-tree (LSM-tree) based KV stores, with implications for throughput, write amplification, and storage density. The result can influence database systems like RocksDB and LevelDB by optimizing compaction strategies.
items.summary_zh: 论文提出改进的基于 LSM-树的键值存储在空间和时间上的权衡，对吞吐、写放大与存储密度等指标有影响，将为 RocksDB、LevelDB 等数据库的合并策略带来优化空间。

items.title_en: Competitive Programmer's Handbook (2018) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 竞争编程者手册（2018）[PDF]
items.summary_en: The PDF version of the Competitive Programmer's Handbook remains a compact, practical reference for algorithms and data structures used by competitive programmers. It continues to serve as a go-to resource for interview prep and contest practice.
items.summary_zh: 《竞争编程者手册》2018 年版 PDF 仍是算法与数据结构的紧凑实用参考，广受竞赛选手欢迎。依然是面试备考与实战练习的首选资源。

items.title_en: Testing 12 different Zigbee temperature/humidity sensors
items.title_zh: 测试 12 种不同的 Zigbee 温湿度传感器
items.summary_en: A hands-on evaluation of 12 Zigbee temperature/humidity sensors, examining accuracy, reliability, and practical suitability for smart home deployments. The results help buyers pick dependable devices.
items.summary_zh: 对12款 Zigbee 温湿度传感器进行了实测评估，关注精度、可靠性及在智能家居部署中的实际适用性，帮助选购更可靠的设备。

items.title_en: Using Blu-ray M-Disk as backup of last resort
items.title_zh: 把 Blu-ray 的 M-Disc 作为最后的备份方案
items.summary_en: Describes using Blu-ray M-Disc as a last-resort archival backup for critical data, emphasizing durability and cross-generation compatibility. Includes practical tips for long-term data integrity and recovery.
items.summary_zh: 介绍将 Blu-ray 的 M-Disc 作为最后的长期归档备份，强调耐久性和跨代兼容性，并给出确保长期数据完整性与可恢复性的实用要点。

items.title_en: Type Safe Generic Data Structures in C (2025)
items.title_zh: C 语言中的类型安全通用数据结构
items.summary_en: This piece explores building type-safe generic data structures in C, likely using macros, _Generic, or tagging techniques to avoid void* pitfalls. It shows how to achieve more robust and maintainable generic abstractions in a language without built-in generics.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨在 C 语言中构建类型安全的通用数据结构，可能借助宏、_Generic 或标签等技术，避免 void* 的风险。展示了在无内建泛型的语言中实现更健壮、可维护的通用抽象的方法。

items.title_en: Show HN: Nightwatch – a Mac menu-bar app that tells you when tonight is clear
items.title_zh: Show HN：Nightwatch——一个在 Mac 菜单栏显示今晚是否晴朗的应用
items.summary_en: Nightwatch is a Mac menu-bar utility that uses weather and astronomy data to tell you when the night will be clear. It exemplifies how lightweight tools can add practical value by leveraging public data sources.
items.summary_zh: Nightwatch 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，利用天气与天文数据指示今晚是否晴朗，为星空观测等活动提供实用辅助。

items.title_en: DEDA – Tracking Dots Extraction, Decoding and Anonymisation Toolkit
items.title_zh: DEDA：跟踪点提取、解码与匿名化工具包
items.summary_en: DEDA provides a toolkit for extracting, decoding, and anonymizing tracking dots, enabling researchers to study marker-based tracking and improve privacy protections. It highlights practical methods for analyzing and mitigating telemetry signals.
items.summary_zh: DEDA 提供一个跟踪点提取、解码与匿名化的工具包，帮助研究者研究基于标记的跟踪并提升隐私保护。它展示了分析与缓解遥测信号的实际方法。

items.title_en: An algorithmic failure beneath the secret ballot
items.title_zh: 秘密投票背后的算法失灵
items.summary_en: A look at how algorithmic processes in elections can fail under the hood, from ballot handling to cryptographic verification.
items.summary_zh: 剖析选举背后的算法层面可能出现的失效，从选票处理到加密校验，指出若干可能破坏选票保密性、选民可验证性与公众信任的故障模式，并提出加强审计的思路。

items.title_en: Differences Between `Foldl` and `Foldr`
items.title_zh: Foldl 与 Foldr 的区别
items.summary_en: Foldl and Foldr are core Haskell folds with different performance characteristics. Foldr can work with infinite lists and is lazy, while Foldl (especially without strictness) can cause space leaks; choosing between them depends on data structure and evaluation strategy.
items.summary_zh: Foldl 与 Foldr 是 Haskell 中的两种折叠操作，有不同的性能特性。Foldr 能处理无限列表且具备惰性求值，而 Foldl（若不使用严格化）可能导致空间泄漏；选择取决于数据结构和求值策略。

items.title_en: Martian chaos terrain
items.title_zh: 火星混沌地貌
items.summary_en: Martian chaos terrain refers to irregular, fractured landscapes on Mars, offering clues about past water activity, subsurface processes, and crustal dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 火星混沌地貌指的是火星上不规则且断裂的地表，为过去水活动、地下过程与地壳动力学提供线索。

items.title_en: The first fully implanted cochlear implant reaches patients
items.title_zh: 首个全植入式人工耳蜗进入患者使用阶段
items.summary_en: A medical milestone as the first fully implanted cochlear implant becomes available to patients, potentially transforming outcomes for severe hearing loss and influencing next-gen implant design.
items.summary_zh: 首个全植入式人工耳蜗投入患者使用，可能改变重度听力损失的治疗效果，并影响未来植入式设备的设计方向。

items.title_en: The era of software quality, or the era of ostriches?
items.title_zh: 软件质量的时代，还是鸵鸟式时代？
items.summary_en: A provocative take on whether the software industry prioritizes speed over quality, urging practices to avoid ‘ostrich’ behavior and improve software dependability.
items.summary_zh: 对软件行业是否把速度置于质量之上提出质疑，呼吁避免“鸵鸟式”态度并提升软件可靠性。

items.title_en: Accountability mechanisms can be joyful
items.title_zh: 問責機制亦可帶來快樂
items.summary_en: Designers are exploring accountability mechanisms that feel constructive rather than punitive. The piece argues that clear feedback loops, inclusive governance, and humane incentives can make accountability something people buy into, not dread. When done right, accountability can improve trust and performance without eroding autonomy.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张问责机制不必只带来压力，应通过清晰的反馈、包容的治理和人性化激励，让参与者愿意承担责任而非抵触。若设计得当，问责可以提升信任和绩效，同时保护自主性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Photoc – Command-line tools for photographers
items.title_zh: Show HN: Photoc——面向摄影师的命令行工具
items.summary_en: Photoc bundles CLI tools to streamline photography workflows—bulk metadata edits, image processing, and asset organization, all from the terminal. It illustrates a niche but growing trend of power-user tooling that can speed up professional photographers' pipelines.
items.summary_zh: Photoc 提供一组命令行工具，帮助摄影师在终端中完成元数据批量编辑、图像处理和资产管理等工作。这个项目体现了一个日益增长的高端工具生态，能显著加速专业摄影师的工作流程。

items.title_en: Show HN: Entombed in a Raycaster
items.title_zh: Show HN：被埋在光线投射器中的实体
items.summary_en: Entombed in a Raycaster showcases a compact raycasting project, likely exploring 2D rendering with a retro aesthetic. It offers an accessible entry point to game-dev techniques, with practical lessons on raycasting performance and simplicity.
items.summary_zh: 《Entombed in a Raycaster》展示了一个紧凑的光线投射项目，以复古美感探索二维渲染。它为游戏开发初学者提供了实用的实现要点，涉及光线投射的性能与简洁性。

items.title_en: Using Theme park rides and smartphones for demonstrating Newtonian mechanics
items.title_zh: 通过主题乐园的设施和智能手机进行牛顿力学的课堂演示
items.summary_en: A hands-on teaching approach uses roller coasters and smartphones to demonstrate Newton’s laws, including data capture via sensors and intuitive demonstrations of inertia and acceleration.
items.summary_zh: 通过主题乐园的设施和智能手机进行牛顿力学的课堂演示，涵盖数据采集与对惯性、加速度等概念的直观体现。文章介绍了兼具趣味性和学术性的教学实验设计。

items.title_en: Ocean the Man Who Listens to Whales
items.title_zh: 倾听鲸鱼的人：Ocean
items.summary_en: Profile of Ocean, a person known for listening to whales, highlighting how acoustic ecology and citizen science intersect with conservation storytelling.
items.summary_zh: 介绍倾听鲸鱼的 Ocean，其经历展示了声学生态学与公民科学在保护鲸类和传播科学故事方面的交汇。

items.title_en: Unruly Folded Sheets
items.title_zh: 不羁的折叠纸张
items.summary_en: A literary-critical piece examining 'Unruly Folded Sheets'—likely a collection or essay—discussing form, texture, and the act of folding as a metaphor for memory or narrative. The review engages with prose style and thematic concerns.
items.summary_zh: 评析《Unruly Folded Sheets》一文，聚焦文本的形式与质地，以及折叠作为记忆或叙事隐喻的运用，探讨散文风格与主题。

items.title_en: The complement of true is true, except when it's false
items.title_zh: 真值的补集：总为真，除非它为假
items.summary_en: This piece delves into logical truth values and complement operations, presenting a provocative angle on how negation interacts with truth. It ties into formal semantics and highlights surprising edge cases that matter for verification, type systems, and logic programming.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨逻辑真值及其补集运算，提出对取非与真值关系的有趣观察，揭示在形式语义、类型系统和逻辑编程中影响深远的边界情形。
